verdicts.evidence: Uptime log f458bd19 at 2026-10-28T21:11:03/23/43Z: public URL → 429 three times, then the POST to ALERT_URL fails with curl (22) 429. Backend http log 21:10:50–21:12:00Z filtered on /api/health holds exactly one request, 21:11:39Z 200, host backend-production-7b10.up.railway.app (the ORIGIN_URL probe), src 152.55.181.187, curl/8.14.1. None of the three public probes reached the origin. No '429' in deploy/cloudflare/worker.js, deploy/railway-alerts/worker.js or infra/, so the 429 came from the Cloudflare platform, not our code.
verdicts.reason: The edge throttled the probe and its alert relay together, while the origin was healthy. That disables the edge-outage alert at the moment it is needed. The rule or source that produced the 429 (WAF, bot or rate limit) needs the Cloudflare dashboard or analytics, which I didn't check.
